chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Abū Baṣīr said to him, “How much is the qāmah?” He said to him, “A cubit. Indeed, the qāmah of the saddle of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was a cubit.”

key_terms.الْقَامَةُ: the measured length used here as a legal standard for prayer time
key_terms.ذِرَاعٌ: a cubit; the stated measure of the qāmah
key_terms.رَحْلِ: saddle; the object whose height is used as the reference measure
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, whose saddle is cited as the standard

ai.seo_question: How much is al-qāmah in hadith about the time of ẓuhr and ʿaṣr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal clarification regarding the measure of al-qāmah in relation to the timing of ẓuhr and ʿaṣr. It states that the qāmah is one cubit, citing the saddle of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as the standard measure.
